outcome: estimated blood loss volume in subsequent delivery
cohort: Women with a history of postpartum hemorrhage (PPH) who had received treatment and later delivered a subsequent pregnancy at the same tertiary center.
finding: The use of PAE to treat previous PPH was associated with a higher estimated blood loss in subsequent deliveries and showed a non-statistically significant trend towards increased incidence of placenta previa and placenta accreta spectrum in subsequent pregnancies.
